---
name: Accessibility feedback
about: Report an access barrier or propose an alternative interaction
title: "[Accessibility] "
labels: accessibility
---

## What were you trying to do?

Describe the task or interaction, not personal medical information.

## Which control method were you using?

For example: LG Magic Remote pointer, arrow fallback, keyboard or another method.

## What made the task difficult?

Describe the actual obstacle, focus behaviour, error, timing or visibility problem.

## What would make it easier?

An alternative interaction, clearer status, larger control, different input option or safer confirmation.

## Reproduction details (optional)

Windows version, app screen, device model and the minimum steps to reproduce.

**Privacy:** Do not include private conversations, research files, passwords, tokens or sensitive personal information in screenshots.
